official_secure_channel_note: Use only the named official website, secure HTTPS form, verified office phone, or in-person office path for sensitive case details and documents. If the current public instructions do not show a secure submission path, call the responsible election office first before sending records.
minimum_necessary_disclosure_note: Send only the personal information the current official process requires. Do not post or send full Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, confidential residence details, court papers, custody records, or other sensitive identifiers through public, unverified, or generalized channels.
operability_now_note: Before relying on this path under same-day or near-cutoff pressure, verify that the responsible office, portal, site, or delivery route is still open and operating right now using the latest official hours/closure notice, current update page, or verified office phone.
deadline_imminence_note: Do not assume an older FAQ, PDF, screenshot, or cached directory still controls today's path. If the cutoff is near or may already have passed, confirm the current live deadline with the responsible office and pivot immediately to the stated fallback or confirmation path if the original route is no longer operable.
current_official_controls_note: The current directly governing state or local election-office source controls for this case. National routing pages, generalized official explainers, and archive summaries are routing aids only and are not substitutes for the current official instruction that directly governs the voter's jurisdiction and election scope.
superseding_notice_note: Older pages, PDFs, screenshots, packet inserts, or archived summaries may remain visible. Follow the most current official notice, form, correction, update, or replacement instruction and use the dated or last-updated cue when available.
unresolved_conflict_stop_note: If current official materials still materially conflict, disagree, or leave a controlling gap, do not synthesize an answer from fragments. Treat that unresolved conflict as a stop condition and use the responsible official office or help path for case-specific confirmation; move to the rights/safety escalation lane when the conflict is paired with likely wrongful denial, intimidation, discrimination, or unsafe exposure.
permitted_challenge_bases_summary: Publish clearly which bases may be used to challenge a voter at the polling place and which bases are not allowed.
challenge_initiators_summary: Publish clearly who may enter a challenge and whether it must be written or sworn.
cure_path_summary: State whether the voter may answer questions, sign an oath or affidavit, or produce a witness and still receive a regular ballot.
fail_safe_ballot_summary: State which challenged, affidavit, or provisional ballot path applies if the challenge is not cured or remains unresolved.
decisionmaker_and_review_summary: Name who decides the immediate ballot path and whether later county-board, canvass, or appeal review exists.
official_help_path_summary: Name the office that resolves time-sensitive challenged-voter questions.

scenario_models.plain_language: The voter's qualifications are challenged before a ballot is issued, but the voter may still complete the required oath, affidavit, answers, or witness step and receive a regular ballot.
scenario_models.permitted_challenge_basis_rule: State the only bases on which the voter may be challenged.
scenario_models.required_oath_or_affidavit_rule: State which oath, affidavit, or sworn questions the voter must complete.
scenario_models.witness_or_question_answer_rule: State whether a witness, answers to questions, or another sworn affirmation cures the challenge.
scenario_models.regular_ballot_rule: State clearly when the challenged voter remains entitled to a regular ballot.
scenario_models.fail_safe_ballot_rule: State what fail-safe ballot path applies if the voter does not or cannot complete the cure step.
scenario_models.decisionmaker_rule: Name who decides at the polling place whether the cure step was completed.

scenario_models.plain_language: The voter does not complete the oath, affidavit, witness, or question-answer step, or the jurisdiction requires a fail-safe ballot pending later review.
scenario_models.permitted_challenge_basis_rule: State which challenge bases still permit movement onto the fail-safe ballot path.
scenario_models.required_oath_or_affidavit_rule: State what challenge paperwork must still be completed before the fail-safe ballot is issued.
scenario_models.witness_or_question_answer_rule: If witness or question-answer steps were offered but not completed, say so plainly.
scenario_models.regular_ballot_rule: State whether a regular ballot is no longer available at this point.
scenario_models.fail_safe_ballot_rule: State whether the voter receives a challenged, affidavit, or provisional ballot and who adjudicates it later.
scenario_models.decisionmaker_rule: Name the polling-place official and later review body, if any.
